column2: Our ancestors, the $$大天使$$s with black $$羽$$...
are said to have lived deep beneath this land...
Spouting magma, $$血$$-freezing cold, and parched deserts.
A stark $$世界$$ of $$弱肉強食$$, where weak life was inevitably culled!!
They say people there had to give their all, every day, just to survive...
They say it was a blessed paradise, perfect for gaining great strength and an indomitable fighting spirit.
But for me, a place like that...
Anyway, our ancestors who lived in that paradise...
guided by the $$救世主$$, $$メフィスト・フェレス$$...
invaded this surface, where $$大邪神$$ and demons ran rampant, and destroyed the $$大邪神$$ army...
They sealed them deep beneath this continent with that $$神の鎖$$, or so we were taught...
